reaction_id: Example - Crystal Modification I from Acetone_Step 1
section_label: Example - Crystal Modification I from Acetone

conditions.heating_method: dissolved completely at the boil (in der Siedehitze), the stated temperature being the boiling point of acetone
conditions.cooling_method: slow cooling to room temperature at a cooling rate of less than 20°C/h (mit einer Kühlrate kleiner 20°C/h)

purification: crystallised from acetone and dried at temperatures below 60°C
procedure_text: [0055] 2 g Tembotrione wurden in der Siedehitze (56°C) vollständig in Aceton gelöst und dann langsam, d.h. mit einer Kühlrate kleiner 20°C/h bis auf Raumtemperatur abgekühlt. Das Kristallisat wird abfiltriert und bei Temperaturen < 60°C getrocknet.
procedure_summary: Tembotrione is dissolved completely in acetone at the boil and the solution is cooled slowly at a controlled rate to the stated endpoint. The crystallisate is filtered off and dried warm, giving tembotrione crystal modification I. The molecule is unchanged; only its crystal form is.
notes: [0055], the acetone preparation of the thermodynamically stable crystal modification I. This is the invention's product form. No bond is formed or broken. Tembotrione goes in and tembotrione comes out; only the crystal lattice differs, so reaction_class is recrystallisation and mechanism_type is not_determinable. The charged tembotrione and the isolated modification are one substance, recorded as two identifiers because the patent names the modifications as separate things and the whole disclosure is about the differences between them. TEMPERATURE: the step has two stated temperatures, a dissolution temperature and a cooling endpoint, and the schema holds one temperature object. type is exact, NOT range, and value_c carries the dissolution temperature 56°C. A range needs two bounds and this step has only one number: the cooling endpoint is Raumtemperatur, for which the patent gives no figure and for which none was invented. The endpoint is carried in cooling_method as the patent words it. This deliberately differs from the ethanol and toluene examples, which do state a numeric endpoint of 7°C and so carry a real two-bound range. The dissolution temperature is printed as the Siedehitze of the solvent, so the number is the solvent's boiling point rather than a measured internal temperature. TIME: null. A cooling rate is given, not a duration, and a duration is NOT computed from the rate and the temperature span. NO YIELD, NO MASS and NO PURITY is stated for the product in this section, nor in any other section this pass read: product_yield_pct, product_purity_pct and the product's quantity fields are all null and nothing was inferred from the 2 g charged. The absence is recorded, not flagged: no listed validation flag covers an absent yield, and there is no arithmetic to fail. The scope of that sentence is deliberate: the document does print weight percentages elsewhere, in [0027] at line 590, a preferred active ingredient quality of more than 20, 90, 95 and 98 Gew.-% of crystal modification I, and in claim 12 at line 816, a composition containing more than 80 Gew.-% of the stable modification. Those are polymorphic content of a preferred quality or of a claimed composition, not the chemical purity or the yield of this preparation, so no numeric field here changes because of them; but it would be false to say the patent prints no percentage anywhere. No reagent, no catalyst, no base and no acid appears; the only materials are the solute and the solvent. German decimal comma: none appears in this paragraph. The only comma-decimal in the sections covered by this pass is the melting point 124,0°C in claim 7, which is not part of any process claim. One step, matching A0's estimate of 1. is_one_pot is false: the patent discloses no one-pot sequence anywhere. Extraction model: Claude Opus 4.5 via Claude Code.
